slides.heading: Max Sum Increasing Subsequence
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Dynamic Programming
slides.narration: Let's solve Max Sum Increasing Subsequence, a hard dynamic programming problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Returns [[maxSum], [subsequence]] for the strictly increasing subsequence with the greatest sum.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Returns maxSum , subsequence for the strictly increasing subsequence with the greatest sum.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: For each index, the best sum ending there extends the best smaller earlier element.
slides.narration: For each index, the best sum ending there extends the best smaller earlier element.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
slides.narration: Enumerating subsequences is exponential. A longest-increasing-subsequence style DP on sums is quadratic.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 1. For each i, scan earlier j with smaller value
3. Rebuild the sequence from the best end
slides.narration: Step by step. First, for each i, scan earlier j with smaller value. Second, keep best sums and predecessors. Third, rebuild the sequence from the best end.

slides.narration: For 10, extend the best earlier smaller value; there's none, so it's just 10.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: Sums starts as a copy. For each i and each earlier smaller j, extend if better and record prev. Rebuild from the best index.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n squared. Space is O of n.

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: Keep it strictly increasing; with negatives, a single element may be best.

slides.heading: Interview tips & follow-ups
bullets: Follow-up: O(n log n) with a BIT keyed by value
slides.narration: A Fenwick tree keyed by value gets it to n log n.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: For each index, the best sum ending there extends the best smaller earlier element.
